text: The Church of Saint Teresa and Saint Joseph, also known as the Church of Saint Teresa and the Barefoot Carmelite Monastery, is a Roman Catholic church in Madrid, Spain. It was declared a Spanish cultural property in 1995.

text: The Roman Theatre is an ancient Roman-era theatre in the city of Cartagena, in the autonomous region of Murcia, Spain. The Roman Theatre was built between 5 BC and the 1st century. In the 3rd century, a market was built on the original site of the theatre.

The Carrousel Bridge  is a bridge in Paris, France, spanning the Seine River, connecting the Tuileries Quay and the Voltaire Quay, near the Palais-Royal Louvre station. Because it is close to the Louvre, this bridge is also known as the Louvre Bridge.

Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport , also known as Jiaodong Airport, is a 4F class civil international transport airport located in Qingdao City, Shandong Province, China. It is a comprehensive hub integrating various modes of transportation such as aviation, railway, subway, and highway. It is positioned as a comprehensive hub for Northeast Asia international shipping, an international aviation logistics center, and a multimodal transport hub, a regional international passenger transfer hub, and a major gateway to Japan and South Korea. It has replaced the civil aviation function of Qingdao Liuting International Airport.

Independence Square, formerly known as Republic Square, is a square in the center of Podgorica, the capital of Montenegro, located in New Podgorica. The area of Independence Square is 15,000 square meters, and the city library and the national art gallery are both located here.

Shengli Farm is a farm located in Raohe County, Shuangyashan City, Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China, and is also a farm under the jurisdiction of the Heilongjiang Provincial Agricultural Reclamation Bureau. The total area of Shengli Farm is 922 square kilometers, the cultivated land area is 693,000 mu, and the total population is 23,000.

The Poznan Royal Castle is a castle located in the Polish city of Poznan. The history of this castle can be traced back to 1249. During the Second World War, the castle was severely damaged, but it has now been partially rebuilt.

Yankee Stadium (English: Yankee Stadium) is a baseball stadium located in the Bronx, New York City, New York State, USA. It is the home field of the New York Yankees of the Major League Baseball. It replaced the old Yankee Stadium that was opened in 1923. The new and old stadiums are only separated by a street, and the location is at the former site of Macombs Dam Park. The new Yankee Stadium was opened on April 4, 2009, and the opening game held on April 16 of the same year was a match between the Yankees and the Cleveland Indians.

Mosna Castle is a historic castle and residence in Poland, located in the southwestern Polish village of Mosna. This castle is one of the most famous monuments in the Upper Silesia region and is often listed among the most beautiful castles in the world. The castle was built in the 17th century.

The New Orthodox Synagogue is a synagogue in the Slovak city of Košice. The designer of this synagogue is the architect Ľudovít Oelschläger, and the exterior is neoclassical architecture. There is a Holocaust monument inside the synagogue.

Phoenix Snow Park is a ski resort located in Bongpyeong-myeon, Pyeongchang County, South Korea. The freestyle skiing and snowboarding competitions of the 2018 Winter Olympics were held here. It can accommodate 18,000 people. It is one of the filming locations of the TV drama "Blue Love and Death".

Siyuan Bridge is a large overpass located in Chaoyang District, Beijing, China, in the northeastern part of Beijing. It connects the Fourth Ring Road and National Highway 101 , and the Beijing Airport Expressway, making it an important hub-type overpass. Siyuan Bridge won the Luban Award for the year 1995.

Nahanni National Park Reserve, located in the northwest region of Canada, is about 500 kilometers west of the capital, Yellowknife. The main purpose is to protect some natural areas of the Mackenzie Mountains.
Luoshe Station is a railway station on the Beijing-Shanghai line, located in Luoshe Town, Huishan District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, with a postal code of 214187.

Jingmiao Temple is a Rinzai Zen temple located in Arida City, Wakayama Prefecture. The mountain name is Medicine King Mountain. The main deity is the Medicine Buddha. In the temple area located in the mountain belly, there are now buildings from the Middle Ages such as the main hall  and the pagoda.
Jihong Bridge is located at the junction of Daoli District and Nangang District in Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province. It is an overpass with a highway on the bridge and a railway under the bridge.

The Ba Wang Gou Tomb Group, located in Ba Wang Gou, Bei Wushi Jia Zi Town, Pingquan City, Chengde City, Hebei Province, China. On July 23, 1982, it was announced as a cultural relics protection unit of Hebei Province, with the type of ancient tombs. In the Tou Dao Ying Zi Village under the jurisdiction of Bei Wushi Jia Zi Town, there is the tomb of the eldest daughter of Emperor Jingzong of the Liao Dynasty, the Grand Princess of Qin and Jin, which is one of the projects of the Ba Wang Gou Tomb Group. According to the epitaph of the princess, this place is the ancestral tomb of her husband Xiao Jixian's family.

head.text: The Ba Wang Gou Tomb Group

text: Sota Building is a large historical building, located at 45 Tang Diego Lopez de Aro Street, in the center of Ensanche district, near Moyua Square.

tail.text: Tang Diego Lopez de Aro Street

text: Xiangyang Tomb Group, located in Xiangyang Village, Yayuan Town, Erdaojiang District, Tonghua City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relics protection unit. The type is ancient tombs, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relics protection unit is managed by the Office of the Cultural Relics Management Committee of Tonghua City. The historical period of the Xiangyang Tomb Group is the late Goguryeo period.

The Wat Si Sawai is located in the Sukhothai Historical Park, a temple in Sukhothai Province, Thailand. The three standing pagodas are the landmarks of Wat Si Sawai, which are said to originate from the primitive religion's worship of the reproductive organs.

Asteroid 3682  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On July 12, 1923, this celestial body was discovered by Karl Wilhelm Reinmuth in Heidelberg. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 113.7651532543136.
Asteroid 3719  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On December 16, 1976, Ludmila Chernykh discovered this celestial body in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 112.1287549801832.
Asteroid 4561  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 13, 1978, this celestial body was discovered by Nikolai Chernykh in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 54.01463767265305.
Asteroid 5534, also known as 5534, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Lise Ottema in Turku on October 15, 1941. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 50.13911403526217.
Asteroid 3701  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On February 20, 1985, Antonín Mrkos discovered this celestial body in Klet. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 297.8040258947907.
Asteroid 6508  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On August 22, 1982, Antonín Mrkos discovered this celestial body in Klet. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 211.3263660209441.

Asteroid 12620, also known as Sima Qian Star, was discovered by Dutch astronomers Cornelis Johannes van Houten, Ingrid van Houten-Groeneveld and American astronomer Tom Gehrels on September 24, 1960. Asteroid 12620 is named after Sima Qian, a historian of the Western Han Dynasty in China and the author of "Historical Records".
Li Bai Crater  is an impact crater on Mercury with a diameter of 120 kilometers. It was named after the Chinese Tang Dynasty poet Li Bai by the International Astronomical Union in 1976.

tail.text: Chinese Tang Dynasty poet Li Bai

text: NGC1097 is a barred spiral galaxy located in the constellation Fornax, about 45 million light years away. It was discovered by Friedrich Wilhelm Herschel on October 9, 1790. As of 2006, three supernovae have been discovered there: SN1992bd, SN1999eu, and SN2003B.

NGC1027 is located in Cassiopeia and was discovered by William Herschel in 1787 as an open cluster. Its position is on the east side of Cassiopeia, between the Heart Nebula and the Soul Nebula, two emission nebulae. However, it has no physical connection with these two nebulae, but is a foreground cluster in front of them, with a distance of about 3,000 light years from the solar system. The visual magnitude of the cluster is 6.7, and a 7th magnitude star can be seen with a 10X50 binoculars, but this star is not a member of this cluster; the brightest star in the cluster is only 9.3.
Asteroid 5359  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On August 24, 1974, this celestial body was discovered by Ludmila Chernykh in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 310.59711.

Yellow giant is a bright giant star with low or medium mass (about 0.5-11 solar masses) in its later evolutionary stage. Its external atmosphere is expanding and thinning, and the increasing radius lowers the surface temperature to 5,200-7,500K. The color of the yellow giant ranges from white to yellow, with spectral types F and G. Approximately 10.6% of the giants are yellow giants.
NGC905 is a galaxy in the constellation of Cetus.

Kepler-4b is one of the first five exoplanets discovered by the Kepler Space Telescope, announced on January 4, 2010. It is located in the constellation Draco, orbiting the star Kepler-4, and is about 1631 light years away from Earth. Its radius is 0.357 of Jupiter's, making it the smallest of the newly discovered five planets, and also the first hot Neptune discovered by the Kepler Space Telescope.

Ceres, seemingly close to a sphere, is the largest asteroid in the asteroid belt after Vesta. The deviation from the sphere is due to large-scale impacts after solidification, forming the Rheasilvia and Veneneia impact basins; in addition, its three-axis size does not conform to hydrostatic equilibrium. Triton is considered to be a dwarf planet captured by Neptune. Phoebe is also a captured celestial body, like Ceres, it has not reached hydrostatic equilibrium, but it may have been in a state of hydrostatic equilibrium in its early development.

Hen2-47 is a young planetary nebula, located in the direction of the constellation Carina in the southern hemisphere, about 6,600 light years away from the earth. Hen2-47 contains six lobes made up of gas and dust, which implies that the star at the center of the nebula has changed the direction of the jet at least three times, throwing matter in three different directions. In each ejection, the star emits a pair of narrow gas jets in opposite directions, ultimately giving the nebula its current shape.
NGC915 is a galaxy in Aries.

M74 is the brightest member of the M74 galaxy group, which has 5-7 galaxies, including the special spiral galaxy NGC660 and several irregular galaxies. Because different methods are used to identify the members of the organization, there are different results, so only those that are fully determined are included in the group, so the actual number of the group is still unknown.
The Battle of Saltanovka, also known as the Battle of Mogilev , took place on July 23, 1812, and was an early battle in the Russo-French War.

The Montgomery Bus Boycott, a large-scale social movement against racial segregation in the United States, was triggered by Rosa Parks, a black woman, who refused to obey the order of James F. Blake, a Montgomery bus driver, on December 1, 1955, and would not give up her seat to a white passenger. Martin Luther King, who participated in the boycott, began to attract attention in the civil rights movement.

The Second Seminole War, also known as the Florida War, was one of the three Seminole Wars fought between the United States and the Native American Seminole people. The war took place in Florida from 1835 to 1842. The Second Seminole War was the most expensive Indian War fought by the United States.

The 2008 Indonesia Badminton Super Series was the 27th Indonesia Open Badminton Championship, which was the first stop of the 2008 World Badminton Super Series. The event was held at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta, Indonesia from June 17 to 22, 2008.

The 2014 Finland Open Badminton Tournament was the 17th Finland Open Badminton Tournament, which is a part of the World Badminton Federation International Challenge and also one of the stops of the 2013/14 European Badminton Federation tour. The tournament was held from April 3 to April 6, 2014, at the Energy Arena in Vantaa, Finland, with a total prize money of $15,000.

The Khabarovsk United Airlines Flight 3949 crash was a regular flight from Nansakhalinsk Airport to Khabarovsk Airport operated by Khabarovsk Airlines. On December 6, 1995, a Tu-154 passenger plane crashed near Bo-Dzhausa Mountain, killing all 98 people on board . The accident was caused by the plane entering a dive while cruising at 34800ft in autopilot mode.

text: The First Opium War refers to the war between China and Britain from 1840 to 1842. The cause of the war was Britain's violation of China's smoking ban, which put great trade pressure on China.

text: The crashed plane is an Airbus A340-313E wide-body jet airliner, equipped with 4 CFM56-5C4/P engines. This model is a high-load derivative of the Airbus A340 series. The registration number of the crashed plane is F-GLZQ, which made its first flight on August 3, 1999, and was delivered to Air France on September 7 of the same year. Since its first use in 1993, the A340 series has always had a very good service record. This accident is the first serious accident of this type of aircraft that caused injuries.

The 2011 Canadian Grand Prix was the seventh race of the 2011 Formula One World Championship. It was held from June 10th to 12th, 2011. The race was won by Jenson Button, who overtook Sebastian Vettel in the final lap. In addition, the safety car was deployed six times in this race, which was the most in history. Moreover, the race took 4 hours, 4 minutes and 39.537 seconds, making it the longest race in F1 history.

The Taekwondo competition of the 2021 Southeast Asian Games, which was postponed to 2022 due to the COVID-19 pandemic, is one of the events of the 31st Southeast Asian Games. It was held from May 16th to 19th, 2022, at the West Lake Sports Hall. The competition includes 19 sub-events, including 5 Poomsae sub-events and 14 sparring sub-events.

head.text: The Taekwondo competition of the 2021 Southeast Asian Games
The Taekwondo competition of the 2021 Southeast Asian Games

text: The 1970 Asian Champion Club Cup was the third highest level club competition in Asia, organized by the Asian Football Confederation, with a total of seven teams participating. The competition was held in Tehran, the capital of Iran, in April, and the Crown won the championship for the first time with the advantage of home court.

The opening ceremony of the 2010 Asian Para Games, which is the opening celebration of the Guangzhou Asian Para Games, was held at the Guangdong Olympic Sports Center located in Guangzhou City on December 12, 2010.

head.text: The opening ceremony of the 2010 Asian Para Games
The opening ceremony of the 2010 Asian Para Games

text: The 2010-11 season of the German Football Bundesliga is the 48th Bundesliga. This season kicked off on August 21, 2010, with the opening match traditionally held a day earlier. The defending champion Bayern Munich defeated Wolfsburg 2-1. The season lasted until May 14, 2011, and the winter break of this season was from December 18, 2010, to January 15, 2011. The German Football Bundesliga updated its logo this season. The weekly schedule includes one match on Friday night, five simultaneous matches on Saturday afternoon, one match postponed to the evening, and one match each on Sunday afternoon and evening.

head.text: The 2010-11 season of the German Football Bundesliga
The 2010-11 season of the German Football Bundesliga

text: In August 2013, Zhang Nan participated in the World Badminton Championships held in Guangzhou, China, and competed in the men's doubles event with Chai Biao as the 9th seed. They had a bye in the first round and advanced to the next round by defeating Chris Adcock/Andrew Ellis of England 2-1 in the second round; however, they were defeated 0-2  by the 3rd seed, Mathias Boe/Carsten Mogensen of Denmark, and stopped at the top 16.

In the summer of 1932, Ni Tuosheng visited Shandong and met Li Changshou in Yantai, which led to the establishment of the first local church in North China. Soon, local churches also emerged in Jinan, the capital of Shandong Province, and Xinjing  under the rule of Manchukuo.

the establishment of the first local church in North China

text: The 2019 Chicago Auto Show was successfully held from February 9 to 18, 2019, and a press reception was pre-arranged on February 7, 2019. In addition, to commemorate the 30th anniversary of its flagship classic sports car NSX, which was first released globally at the 1989 Chicago Auto Show, ACURA held a small discussion and exchange session at the venue.

In Western Europe, numerous church institutions provided fertile ground for the development of Romanesque art. The Cluniac movement in the Burgundy region in the 11th and 12th centuries also had a significant impact, with the Cluny Abbey once being the largest church in Western Europe. Some of the most important masterpieces of Romanesque architecture were also completed in France. Representative works include the Abbey of Saint-Sernin, Cluny Abbey, the Church of Saint-Savin-sur-Gartempe, and the Cathedral of Périgueux in France, as well as Durham Cathedral in England.

In June 2019, Pia Zebadiah Bernadet and Amri Sanawi participated in the Malaysia Badminton International Series. They defeated the 4th seed of the tournament, their teammates Andika Ramadiansyah and Beny Fitriani Romadini, with a score of 2-0  in the mixed doubles final, winning the mixed doubles championship of the International Series.

The Industrial Revolution in the UK refers to a series of economic, social, and technological changes that occurred from the late 18th century to the early 19th century. It promoted the rapid development of machinery manufacturing and textile industries, laying the foundation for the birth of modern industrial civilization.

tail.text: from the late 18th century to the early 19th century

text: The New York International Auto Show (English: New York International Auto Show) is an auto exhibition held in New York State, USA, at the end of March or the beginning of April each year. The main venue is the Jacob Javits Convention Center in Manhattan. The auto show started in 1900 and was held at the New York Theater from 1956 to 1987. It was then moved to the Jacob Javits Convention Center where it has been held ever since. Its main exhibitors are the Greater New York Automobile Dealers Association (GNYADA) and the International Motor Press Association (IMPA).

tail.text: at the end of March or the beginning of April each year
Greater New York Automobile Dealers Association

text: The Zengcheng Xintang incident occurred on the evening of June 10, 2011, in Xintang Town, Zengcheng City, Guangdong Province, China , Dadun Village. The incident was triggered by a large-scale protest and riot after a pregnant woman from Sichuan, Wang Lianmei, who was running a street stall, was beaten by urban management officers.

Afriqiyah Airways Flight 771  was a regular flight from Johannesburg, South Africa to Tripoli, the capital of Libya. On May 12, 2010, at 6 a.m. local time, the Airbus A330-202 operating this flight crashed while landing at Tripoli International Airport. Of the 93 passengers and 11 crew members on board, only a 10-year-old Dutch boy survived.

Operation Foxley (English: Operation Foxley) was a plan to assassinate Hitler, devised by the British Special Operations Department in 1944. Although all the preparatory work had been completed, the plan was never executed. World War II historians estimate that the original date should be from July 13 to 14, 1944, when Hitler visited Berghof.

On November 29, 2012, Yan Qingbiao announced that his eldest son, Yan Kuanheng, a former task-oriented representative of the Non-Party Unity Alliance, would participate in the by-election. On December 14, Yan Kuanheng completed the party registration as a member of the Kuomintang. On December 18, Yan Kuanheng registered for the election with the recommendation letter from the Kuomintang to the Taichung City Election Committee. On December 19, the Kuomintang officially nominated Yan Kuanheng for the election.

The Araucanía Region is the 12th region from north to south in Chile. The capital is Temuco. About one-third of the population in this region are Mapuche people, which is the highest proportion among all regions in Chile. During the period from 1900 to 1930, despite the economic recession in other parts of Chile, the population of Araucanía also grew significantly. Araucanía subsequently became one of the main agricultural areas in Chile, known as the "Granary of Chile". The administrative region of Araucanía was established in 1974, located in the core of the larger historical area of Araucanía.
Shinano Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to Tōsandō, also known as Shinshū. The territory of Shinano Province is approximately the present Nagano Prefecture.

Nyeri (officially known as Nyeri Municipality) is a town in Kenya and is the administrative capital of the Central Province. The town is located about 150 kilometers north of Nairobi, the capital of Kenya (about 2 hours by car). In 1999, the most recent official census in Kenya showed that the population of the town was 98,908, but it is estimated that the population could grow to between 200,000 and 300,000 in the future.

Bannu District, a district in the southern part of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. The total area is 12,270 square kilometers, and the total population is 677,346. The county seat is located in Bannu.

Gran Sabana is a region located in the southeast of Venezuela. It includes the Guiana Highlands, the southeast of Bolivar State, and further extends to Brazil and Guyana. Its area is 10,820 square kilometers. A part of it is Venezuela's second largest national park - Canaima National Park. The average annual temperature is 20°C, and the average night temperature can reach 13°C. Gran Sabana has a rich geographical form, with rivers, waterfalls, canyons, valleys, dense forests and sparse grasslands. There are a large number of local unique plants and animals.

The Chongoni Rock Art Area, located in the central highlands of Malawi, is a World Heritage Site in Malawi. The Chongoni Rock Art Area covers an area of 126.4 square kilometers and was listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2006. The rock paintings in the art area reflect the local culture.

Port-Cartier is a town in the North Shore region of Quebec, Canada. It is located on the north shore of the Saint Lawrence River, 63 kilometers southwest of Sept-Îles. It has an area of 1073 square kilometers and a population of 6,412 (as of 2001).

Hitachi Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to the Tokaido region, also known as Changzhou. The territory of Hitachi Province is roughly equivalent to most of the current Ibaraki Prefecture , and it contains Kasumigaura, the second largest lake in Japan.

In 1816, Mainz was assigned to the Grand Duchy of Hesse-Darmstadt, and its political and economic status declined significantly, gradually becoming an unimportant provincial city. The fortresses around the city hindered its development. During this period, almost no significant events occurred in the city. The Mainz Carnival was formed here in 1837. It was not until 1886 that the city was expanded and the population increased dramatically. Compared with other surrounding cities, such as Wiesbaden, the overall development of Mainz was not ideal due to its fortress function.

The Roman Catholic Diocese of Ajaccio is a diocese of the Roman Catholic Church in France, belonging to the Archdiocese of Marseille. The diocese covers the entire island of Corsica, with 258,200 parishioners  in 2012, 434 parishes, and seventy-one priests. The current bishop of the diocese is Olivier de Germay. Traditionally, the diocese was established in the 3rd century and originally belonged to the Archdiocese of Pisa. After the signing of the Concordat in 1801, it became the only diocese on the island and was transferred to the jurisdiction of the Archdiocese of Aix.

head.text: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Ajaccio

text: Spanish Guinea was a former colony of the Spanish Empire in Africa, which became Equatorial Guinea after gaining independence in 1968.

Redcar and Cleveland is a unitary authority area in the ceremonial county of North Yorkshire, England. The main cities are Redcar, Saltburn-by-the-Sea, and Guisborough. The population was 139,132 in 2001. It is part of the Tees Valley economic area.

Segou, located on the Niger River, is a city in the central-southern part of Mali. It is about 235 kilometers northeast of Bamako. The city was established by the Bozo people in 1620, about 10 kilometers from where the town is now. Segou is the third largest city in Mali, with a settled population of about 100,000 people.
Shuipu Township is a township-level administrative unit under Xiangcheng County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

Langenfeld is a city in the Düsseldorf administrative district of North Rhine-Westphalia in western Germany, located between Düsseldorf and Cologne, with a population of 59,056 in 2009. The city has convenient transportation, and the nearby area has Cologne/Bonn Airport.

tail.text: Düsseldorf administrative district of North Rhine-Westphalia

text: Finley is a census-designated place in Benton County, Washington, United States. The population was 6,012 at the 2010 United States Census. This city is located southwest of Kennewick.
Lacey, located in Thurston County, Washington, United States, is a suburb of Olympia. The population was 42,393 at the 2010 United States Census.

Monzón is a town in the province of Huesca, in the autonomous community of Aragon, Spain, with a population of 17,050. Monzón is the birthplace of Conchita Martínez. Richelieu once signed a treaty here with Gaspar de Guzmán, Count Duke of Olivares. This place was once the capital of the Kingdom of Aragon.

Reiko Kiuchi, a Japanese female voice actor. Born in Tokyo. Freelance. Former stage name Kiuchi Reiko. Blood type A. Representative works include "Digimon Adventure 02"  and "Bit the Adventure King" series .

Charles VI le Insense (December 3, 1368 - October 21, 1422), also known as Lovely Charles, was the king of the Valois dynasty in France (reigned from 1381 to 1422). He was the son of Charles V and Joanna of Bourbon. After his father's diligent governance, France fell into chaos again due to Charles VI's mental illness.

Hu Cai , originally named Shen Chengli, Shen Chaozhi, pen names include Hu Cai, Wang Mu, Shen Jiang, Shen Xiaotian, Xin Yu, etc., male, from Lixian County, Hebei, a Chinese writer, former chairman of the Shaanxi Provincial Federation of Literary and Art Circles, and representative of the sixth and seventh National People's Congress.

Nishino Warrior is a professional baseball player from Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture, Japan. He serves as a pitcher and plays for the Chiba Lotte Marines in Japanese professional baseball.

text: Wang Yuren was born into the Wang family of Taihe Meigang, a family that has been extremely prestigious and produced many talents since the Song Dynasty. His great-grandfather was Wang Xuejin; his grandfather was Wang Guocheng; his father was Wang Qinchen, and his mother was Mrs. Liang.
Ryota Moritsu (April 6, 1986 -), a Japanese football player, currently plays for Ehime FC in J2 League, and is a former member of the Japanese national football team.

Luis Guillermo Solís Rivera is a Costa Rican politician affiliated with the Citizens' Action Party. He won the Costa Rican general election in 2014 after two rounds of voting, and successfully became the President of Costa Rica.
On October 10, 2010, Liu Ye had a son named Liu Nuo Yi. Because the child's mother, Anais Martane, is French, the child's facial features are particularly three-dimensional.
Jiang Fan (1985 - ) is a Chinese entrepreneur, currently serving as the president of Alibaba Group's overseas digital business division.

text: In 1996, Eason Chan fell in love with Xu Jinglei, a female actress from Hong Kong, China. In 1997, the two began to live together. In October 2004, Eason Chan's daughter, Constance Chan, was born.

On June 23, 2008, Andy Lau and Zhu Liqin registered their marriage in Las Vegas, USA. On May 9, 2012, Zhu Liqin gave birth to their daughter, Liu Xianghui, in Hong Kong's Yanghe Hospital. After Liu Xianghui was born, a few people in the circle who had seen Liu Xianghui's face said that her ears looked like Andy Lau, and she was very pretty.

George David Gatewood (1940 - ) is an American astronomer, currently an emeritus professor at the University of Pittsburgh and the Allegheny Observatory. His research specialties are astronomical instruments, statistics, stellar astronomy, nearby stellar astronomical measurements, and exoplanets. Gatewood attracted attention in 1996 when he claimed to have discovered a multi-planet system near Earth, but his discovery has not yet been confirmed.

On October 24, 2019, He Youjun had a son named He Guangshen. On November 2, 2021, He Youjun's cousin revealed that his sister-in-law, Xi Mengyao, had safely given birth to a second child.

Princess Yining , a princess of the Tang Dynasty, was one of the eighteen daughters of Li Chun, the eleventh emperor of the Tang Dynasty in China. Her biological mother is unknown, and the history books only recorded her title as Princess Yining. Princess Yining passed away before she reached the marriageable age.

tail.text: a princess of the Tang Dynasty

text: Germ cell tumor (English: germ cell tumor, abbreviated as GCT), is a tumor that occurs in germ cells. Germ cell tumors may be malignant or benign, and they usually occur in the gonads (ovaries or testicles), which are a type of tumor caused by congenital defects during embryonic development.

tail.text: a type of tumor caused by congenital defects during embryonic development

text: Sensory analysis, also known as sensory evaluation, is a scientific discipline that applies experimental design and statistical analysis techniques to human senses , with the aim of evaluating consumer goods. This discipline requires product testers and recorders to conduct group discussions. Applying statistical techniques to the results may reveal inferences and information hidden beneath the results. Most large consumer goods companies have departments responsible for sensory analysis.

Compulsive behavior, also known as affectation, is a repetitive and persistent behavior. The person involved cannot benefit or feel satisfied from this behavior, but it is difficult to stop the inner impulse to do this behavior. This type of behavior can generally be observed in ordinary people, and may be triggered by inner worries and anxiety. It is usually a mild and limited repetitive behavior, not pathological. One of the main reasons for compulsive behavior is considered to be obsessive-compulsive disorder.

text: Botryoid Sarcoma, also known as Sarcoma botryoides or Botryoid Rhabdomyosarcoma, is a subtype of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. It is often detected in hollow cell walls and mucosal structures, such as the nasopharynx, common bile duct, bladder of infants or children, or the vagina of females under eight years old.

Decubitus ulcer, also known as pressure sore or pressure ulcer, is a type of skin ulcer. It is caused by long-term pressure or combined shearing and friction on the skin tissue, leading to ischemic necrosis. It is common in people who are bedridden for a long time due to paralysis or surgery. General measures to prevent decubitus ulcers include: strengthening nutrition, frequently turning bedridden people, and using water beds to disperse pressure.

text: School Phobia, also known as Campus Phobia, School Refusal, or Fear of School, is a psychological disorder in children and adolescents. Chest pain, also known as chest tightness or chest discomfort, is a common symptom of a series of serious diseases, and generally needs to be considered for emergency treatment when this symptom appears. Although chest pain is not necessarily caused by heart disease, doctors must also consider its possibility in the diagnosis process. Chest pain related to the heart is called angina.

Hematocolpos, a medical condition, refers to the vagina filled with menstrual blood, which usually occurs in women with hymen atresia during menstruation. A related symptom is hematometra, which is menstrual blood in the uterus. It appears in girls with primary amenorrhea during their first menstruation, causing recurrent pelvic pain and accompanied by pelvic masses. It may also be caused by congenital cervical stenosis or the impact of certain surgical treatments.

Mushroom poisoning refers to the toxic reaction caused by the ingestion of poisonous mushrooms due to their toxic substances . If the symptoms are mild, there may only be gastrointestinal discomfort, and it can be fatal in severe cases. The toxins in mushrooms are secondary metabolites produced by fungi. The cause of mushroom poisoning is mostly due to the misidentification of poisonous mushrooms as other edible mushrooms, leading to accidental ingestion. Many poisonous mushrooms and edible mushrooms are also quite similar in color and shape.

text: Gastroenteritis is defined as vomiting or diarrhea caused by infection of the small intestine or colon. The changes in the small intestine are usually non-inflammatory, while the changes in the colon are often inflammatory. The number of pathogens causing infection also varies, from as few as one  to as many as 10 to the power of 8 .

Muscle tension disorder is divided into eyelid spasm, craniofacial muscle tension disorder, spasmodic dysphonia, spasmodic torticollis, writer's cramp, hemiplegic muscle tension disorder, and generalized muscle tension disorder according to the affected part.

Brenner tumors, a rare type of tumor that occurs in the ovaries, are a type of surface epithelial-stromal tumor. Most of these tumors are benign, but they can also deteriorate into malignant tumors. Most cases are accidentally discovered during pelvic examinations or during abdominal surgery. It is very rare for Brenner tumors to occur in other parts, including the testicles.

Adenomyoma, is a type of mixed tumor composed of glandular and muscular tissues. In obstetrics and gynecology, it is a type of endometrial ectopic. Most adenomyomas are unilateral and accompanied by dysmenorrhea and pelvic pain, usually removed by laparoscopic surgery.

The Black Conger, also known as the Black Hole Conger, is one of the species of the Conger eel family in the suborder Congrinae of the order Anguilliformes of the class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, from Mauritania to the waters of Namibia, and can inhabit depths of up to 60 meters. It can grow up to 100 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in shallow reef areas. It is carnivorous, feeding on crustaceans and other creatures, and can be used as a food fish.

The Yellow-spotted moray (scientific name: Echidna xanthospilos), also known as Yellow-spotted snake moray, Yellow-spotted moray, Money eel, Potato eel, Tiger eel, is one of the species of the Moray eel family in the suborder of snake eels of the order of Anguilliformes of the class of ray-finned fishes, distributed in the waters of Indonesia and Papua New Guinea in the central and western Pacific, it is a benthic fish, carnivorous, with unknown habits.

The High-bodied Purple Fish, also known as the High-bodied Princess Bream, is one of the species of the family Pomacentridae, suborder Percoidei, order Perciformes, class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from Canada to the waters of Santa Catarina, Brazil, with a habitat depth of 24-370 meters. This fish has large eyes, a pinkish-red back, pink sides, and a silver-white belly. Except for the yellow tail and dorsal fins, all other fins are slightly transparent pink. It has 10 dorsal fin spines, 10-11 dorsal fin soft rays, 3 anal fin spines, and 7-8 anal fin soft rays. It can reach a length of 56 centimeters, is carnivorous, and feeds on fish. It can be used as a food fish.

The Yellow-breasted Hidden Beauty Fish, a species of the Pomacentridae family in the suborder of the Lutjaniformes of the Perciformes order of the Actinopterygii class, is distributed in the Canaveral River Basin in Central America, Panama. It can grow up to 9 centimeters in length and inhabits the bottom waters of streams. Its habits are unknown.

It can grow up to 4 centimeters in length and inhabits the bottom waters of rivers with rapid currents and gravel bottoms. Its habits are unknown.

Myxidium cirrhinae, also known as the herring myxidium, is a species of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidiidae family. In China, it is distributed in Guangdong and other places, leading a parasitic life, parasitizing in the kidneys of herring.

The Greenback Flounder is one of the species of the Rhombosoleidae family in the order Pleuronectiformes, suborder Pleuronectoidei, class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the waters and brackish waters of Australia and New Zealand, with a habitat depth of up to 100 meters and a body length of up to 45 centimeters. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in sandy seabed areas and estuaries. It is carnivorous, but its habits are unknown. It can be used as food fish and game fish.

The Speckled Flounder is one of the species of the Pleuronectidae family, under the order Pleuronectiformes and suborder Pleuronectoidei of the class Actinopterygii. It is a subtropical marine fish, distributed in the southwestern Pacific Ocean in New Zealand; the eastern Pacific Ocean from the Gulf of California in Mexico to the waters of Peru, inhabiting depths of 1-121 meters. It can reach a length of 15.7 centimeters, dwelling in soft bottom waters, but its habits are unknown. It can be used as a food fish.
